rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for wasting money, time, opportunities, or other resources.

example.english: We can't squander any more time on these pointless arguments.
example.traditional: 我哋唔可以再嘥時間喺呢啲無謂爭拗上。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 m4 ho2 ji5 zoi3 saai1 si4 gaan3 hai2 ni1 di1 mou4 wai6 zang1 aau3 soeng6

rows.note: Use this specifically when someone spends money recklessly or without control.

example.english: Don't squander your money on all these useless things.
example.traditional: 你唔好再亂咁使錢買埋啲冇用嘅嘢喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 lyun6 gam3 sai2 cin2 maai5 maai4 di1 mou5 jung6 ge3 je5 laa3

rows.note: Use this for lavish or extravagant spending, especially in formal or written contexts.

example.english: When they were young, they would squander their family fortune, and in old age they could only live on their savings.
example.traditional: 佢哋年輕嗰陣成日揮霍家產，晚年只可以靠積蓄過活。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 nin4 heng1 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 fai1 fok3 gaa1 caan2 maan5 nin4 zi2 ho2 ji5 kaau3 zik1 cuk1 gwo3 wut6
